title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Arrangement Deposits
content:
**Arrangement terms and payment card — the deposit that opens a monthly payment arrangement on an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account.**

## The deposit

An arrangement deposit is the patient's own payment that opens a monthly payment arrangement on a coverage account.

- **One entry on the oldest open charge.** For an arrangement deposit, and only for an arrangement deposit, the payment is posted as one patient-payment entry naming the account's oldest open charge; every other patient payment that names no charge remains under the base rule, allocated across all of the patient's coverage accounts oldest open charge first, one entry per charge.
- **Posted whole.** For an arrangement deposit, and only for an arrangement deposit, a deposit larger than the named charge's open amount is still posted whole on that one entry, its excess carried by the account balance toward the account's next open charges; every other patient payment that exceeds the open amount of the charges it is applied to remains under the base rule, its remainder posted with no charge named as a credit.
- **Amount, method and reference.** For an arrangement deposit, and only for an arrangement deposit, the entry is posted for the exact amount the patient pays, with the payment method the patient uses and, as payment reference, the confirmation code the payment network issues for that deposit; every other patient payment remains under the base rule, posted for the exact amount paid with the payment method used and the payment reference the patient quotes copied verbatim.
- **Confirmation code.** For an arrangement deposit, and only for an arrangement deposit, the confirmation code is issued for that deposit alone and is never shared with another payment entry on the account; for every other patient payment the base rule stands, and a payment reference already posted on the account is never posted again for the same charge.

## When the deposit is figured

The arrangement deposit is figured only after every charge the account's hardship approval covers carries its hardship discount.

The arrangement deposit is not worked out until every coinsurance charge that a payment made since the latest statement paid in full within the prompt-pay window carries its prompt-pay discount.

## Paying the deposit: `pay_arrangement_deposit_e794f585`

**Capability.** The tool takes, in person, the deposit that opens a monthly payment arrangement on a coverage account. The patient (or the person paying for them) pays the deposit on the spot with their own card or bank account. One call takes the payment, writes one patient-payment entry dated today against the named open charge with the confirmation code the payment network issues, and lowers the account's patient balance by the amount paid. The patient sees the payment on the account history straight away.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `pay_arrangement_deposit_e794f585` with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | the reference number of the coverage account (the insurance coverage record on the patient's file) the deposit is paid on, as given to the patient by the agent from the coverage lookup | identifier |
| `applied_to_entry_id` | the reference number of the open patient charge the deposit is applied to, as given to the patient by the agent from the patient-account ledger lookup | identifier |
| `payment_method` | how the patient pays | exactly one of `card` (a credit or debit card the patient holds, keyed in now), `ach` (a bank-account transfer authorised now from the patient's checking or savings account), `check` (a paper check handed over at a Summit Ridge branch counter today), `hsa_fsa_card` (a health savings or flexible spending account card), `none` (no money moves at all, which never applies to a deposit actually paid) |
| `amount` | the deposit paid, in USD | a positive figure with 2 decimal places; stored exactly as given, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with `payment_entry_id` (the reference of the new payment entry), `confirmation_code` (the code the payment network issued for this payment), `coverage_id` (the account paid on), `applied_to_entry_id` (the charge the money settles), `payment_method` (the method used), `amount` (the deposit paid, USD with 2 decimals), `posting_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD), `patient_balance` (the account balance once the deposit is posted, USD with 2 decimals) and `status`, the string "paid". A receipt whose status is "paid" means the deposit is on the account; the confirmation code is the patient's to keep for their records.
